usage: agentware recall [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--top-k TOP_K]
                        [--token-budget TOKEN_BUDGET] [--category CATEGORY]
                        [--strategy {bm25,bm25+acr}] [--acr] [--as-of AS_OF]
                        [--scope {curated,work,all,shared}] [--team TEAM]
                        [--include-shared]
                        query

positional arguments:
  query                 free-text query to rank KB entries against

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --top-k TOP_K         max entries to return before budgeting (default: 5)
  --token-budget TOKEN_BUDGET
                        trim so cumulative est. tokens <= budget (default:
                        1500); output is already budget-bounded — never pipe
                        recall through `head`
  --category CATEGORY   restrict ranking to a single category
  --strategy {bm25,bm25+acr}
                        ranking strategy (default: the gated default —
                        bm25+acr iff the recorded ACR win gate passed, else
                        bm25; bm25+acr applies the ACR provenance+freshness
                        prior over BM25)
  --acr                 shorthand for --strategy bm25+acr (opt into the ACR
                        re-rank; reorders within the BM25 set only)
  --as-of AS_OF         YYYY-MM-DD date for ACR freshness decay (default:
                        today; PIN it for reproducible runs)
  --scope {curated,work,all,shared}
                        corpus scope: curated (indexed entries only, default),
                        work (plans/worklogs in work/), all (both), shared
                        (org-shared entries only). work/ entries are ephemeral
                        (never indexed).
  --team TEAM           restrict recall to a single team's entries ('shared'
                        selects org-shared entries).
  --include-shared      add ALL org-shared knowledge (not just shared skills)
                        to the caller-team default scope.
